name: Kitsune Will

abilities.name: Fox Glamour
abilities.effect: A glamour of shifting light hides the tamer for about 5 seconds; afterimage decoys flicker nearby.

abilities.name: Fox Hop
abilities.effect: A light quick hop forward, leaving a rose afterimage as a decoy.

acquire.equipPiece: One tail of rose foxfire worn at the hip like a sash ornament (the only equipped piece), flicking as you hop.

abilities.name: Nine-Tail Mirage
abilities.effect: Nine tails sweep and foes see nine of the tamer: they lose aim and flee phantom flames (bosses resist).

abilities.name: Kitsunebi Ring
abilities.effect: A ring of nine orbiting foxfires closes in and burns foes without igniting terrain.

integrate.transformation: Whole body becomes a fox beastman in layered plate: fox head with tall pointed ears and amber slit eyes, rose-white hair, cream chest ruff, fine-clawed hands with a foxfire fan, digitigrade fox legs and nine tails each tipped with a floating foxfire.

equip.weapon: A folding war-fan of nine foxfire ribs that cuts and flicks fire.
equip.armor: Layered rose-and-cream shrine-maiden-style plate with a skirt of nine tail-guard fans and a ruffed collar.
equip.hair_eyes: Long rose-white hair with fox ears; amber slit eyes with a pink glow.
equip.aura: Floating foxfire orbs and a rose-gold glamour haze.

lore: A fox spirit whose tails grow with its mana; its will bends light and mind with foxfire and glamour.
pitch: The Kitsune is a clever nine-tailed fox spirit of Japanese myth that rules glamour and foxfire. Acquire keeps you human with one rose-fire tail ornament at the hip, lending quick hops and a glamour that hides you. Integrate makes you a slender fox beastman in layered shrine-maiden-style plate with tall ears and nine tail fans, a fast illusionist whose mirage and foxfire ring are paid for with a fragile body and a strain that spikes when an illusion misfires.
untrained: An untrained holder is fooled by their own glamour: strain spikes when an illusion misfires and they lose track of which tail is real, so foes sometimes see the true holder and the holder sees decoys. Canon: a will that is not suppressed or balanced disrupts body and mana core and can eventually kill the holder, so the first Awakening (forced, a spark in the core) is the most dangerous moment and training both cores is the cure.

spirit.echo: A slender fox-beastman on digitigrade legs with large pointed fox ears, a narrow muzzle and amber slit eyes, a cream chest ruff, fine-clawed hands, and a fan of nine tails each tipped with pale rose foxfire.
spirit.look: A rose-pink orb that flickers like a candle flame with nine thin curling tails of pale fire spiralling inside.
